minors.issue: "study online courses" is an unnatural verb-object collocation. In standard English a learner "takes" (or "enrolls in") a course; "study" collocates with a subject/field (study biology, study distant stars), not with the container word "course". The same wording is repeated in the detail-question choice and the sentence-parsing data, so a fix must be applied in all three places.
minors.evidence: 본문: "A student can study online courses that were made an ocean away." / 선택지: "A student can study courses made an ocean away." / page3 sentence 8: { "role": "V", "text": "can study" }
minors.suggestion: Change to "A student can take online courses that were made an ocean away." and update the Q3 choice to "A student can take courses made an ocean away." plus page3 sentence 8's V segment to "can take". (The Korean translation "온라인 강의를 공부할 수 있다" reads fine either way, but "수강할 수 있다" would match better.)
